prompt: Draw me the Plough, and tell me why we see shapes in the stars.

scenes.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 340" fill="currentColor" font-family="serif" font-style="italic" font-size="18">
  <title>The Plough, joined star to star</title>
  <defs>
    <filter id="glow"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2.5" result="blur"/><feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge></filter>
    <symbol id="star" viewBox="-10 -10 20 20"><circle r="4"/></symbol>
  </defs>
  <polyline points="70,110 170,95 260,120 330,160 340,250 470,265 485,175 330,160" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-opacity="0.45" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <g filter="url(#glow)">
    <use href="#star" x="60" y="100" width="20" height="20"/>
    <use href="#star" x="160" y="85" width="20" height="20"/>
    <use href="#star" x="250" y="110" width="20" height="20"/>
    <use href="#star" x="320" y="150" width="20" height="20"/>
    <use href="#star" x="330" y="240" width="20" height="20"/>
    <use href="#star" x="460" y="255" width="20" height="20"/>
    <use href="#star" x="475" y="165" width="20" height="20">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.6;1" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </use>
  </g>
  <text x="300" y="315" text-anchor="middle" fill-opacity="0.75">seven stars, one shape we agreed to see</text>
</svg>

beats.say: The stars are not arranged for us.
They are scattered at every distance, and none of them knows its neighbour.
We join seven of them, and a plough appears, or a bear, or a ladle, depending on who is looking.
A shape in the stars is a story we tell together, and keep telling.
